events.description: Checks the file with the mapping, saving nothing; the counts and problems come back for review.
events.name: onDryRun

events.description:
Imports for real. Call `progress` with the share done, from 0 to 1, to fill the bar; never called, it stays
indeterminate. Resolve with the final counts, or with nothing to keep the dry run's; reject to offer a retry.
events.name: onImport
events.type: (mapping: Readonly<Record<string, string | null>>, progress: (fraction: number) => void) => Promise<void | ImportDryRun>

events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

events.description: Reads the picked file: its columns, a sample and the row count. Reject to say it can't be read.
events.name: onRead

props.description: The fields a column can fill; the required ones must be matched before the file is checked.
props.name: fields

props.description: The extensions or MIME types taken. Defaults to CSV and Excel (`.csv`, `.xlsx`, `.xls`).
props.name: acceptedFileTypes

props.description: Where the template file is; left out, there is no template link.
props.name: templateUrl

props.description: The element that opens the dialog; left out, the app opens it through `isOpen`.
props.name: trigger

props.description: The dialog's title; defaults to the catalogue's "Import".
props.name: title

props.description: One sentence under the title: what is being imported.
props.name: description

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen
